items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's right. That's right. St. Henry and Jim Robinson. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. Some of those. Yeah.

ctx.x: Actually how many years you went back footed down there by Ironton. That's why he come from a little farm that's called Ironton down the coast. It was down near the Magnolia Plantation.
That's right. That's right. St. Henry and Jim Robinson.
That's right. Some of those. Yeah. But he was just a little bit further than Magnolia. Further down the river. Yeah. He was the place where he was Ironton.
